method: Measured closed entire GLB mesh radius, including feet and hatch; 0.01m radial margin per boss. Uniform scale also shrinks hatch and pilot free space. No FitsAll claim.
escapeWorldScalePolicy: Inherit the live boss StartDock world matrix, including boss world scale. Table uniformScale is a local prefab factor; never shrink pilot geometry to fit. World radius equals boss world scale times scaledClosedRadius. Open only after free undock.

LANDING_POD.centerOfGeometryNote: Pivot and whole pressure skin are preserved. Moving hatch shifts geometry centroid; root placement must use StartDock, not recenter on posed bounds.

BRIGADIER.alignment: T(asset) * scale * StartDock.localPosition = boss live StartDock world position. Preserve live dock quaternion; no boss changes.
BRIGADIER.openingPolicy: Undock and clear support hull before opening; scale sweep and exit corridor with entire asset.

flightRecipe.phase1: Translate world +Y 1.2m from live StartDock before any heading change; keep capsule upright.
flightRecipe.phase2: After full lift, turn toward runtime escape route; no fixed world pilot heading assumed.
